info.title: synclane
info.description: The synclane command: turns a working curl into a SyncLane recipe by looking at a real answer, and runs a recipe for two pages without a database.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Turns a working curl into a SyncLane recipe, and tests a recipe without a database.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Turns a working curl into a recipe: sends it once and writes what the answer shows, with a comment beside every guess.

options.name: --out
options.description: The file to write. By default, the name of the resource with .jsonc, in the current folder.

options.name: --force
options.description: Replace the file if it exists. [default: False]

arguments.name: CURL
arguments.description: The curl command, pasted after 'synclane init' as it was copied. Leave it out to pipe it in: pbpaste | synclane init.

commands.name: test
commands.description: Runs a recipe for two pages through the real handler, without a database, and says whether its records, key and paging work.

options.name: --owner
options.description: The owner key to test with, for a recipe that uses {{owner.*}}.

options.name: --since
options.description: How far back the window reaches: a length such as 7d, 12h or 30m, or a date. [default: 7d]

arguments.name: RECIPE
arguments.description: The recipe file, such as one 'synclane init' wrote.
